_comment: Canonical product-fact store (SEO/GEO plan Phase 2.3; spec ENTITY/DEVGEO-008). Single source of truth for facts that appear in structured data and (progressively, Phases 3-5) in page copy. build/prerender.mjs consumes it for the entity graph and offers; build/verify.mjs FAILS the build when the rendered site disagrees with this file. Every fact here is either site-stated (extracted 2026-08-31) or owner-approved (pricing = live Stripe retail plans, decision D5). Change a fact here first; never let a page and this file drift apart.

product.name: ClinixSummary
product.siteTitle: ClinixSummary – The AI Medical Scribe Foundation

org.name: GATMEDI
org.legalName: Gacrux Advanced Technologies in Medicine Ltd
org._sameas_note: App-store listings + the social profiles linked in the site footer. Spec ENTITY alignment: sameAs must list the profiles the site itself claims - nothing else.

pricing._source: Live Stripe retail plans (owner decision D5, 2026-08-31: these are public). The 2026-08-31 feasibility audit found the site advertised Pioneer at $18.99 while Stripe charges $19.99 - this file carries what is ACTUALLY charged, and verify.mjs keeps the pages honest.
pricing._offercount_note: 5 = the priced retail plans. The Enterprise card is custom-quoted, not an offer with a price, so it does not count (the old hardcoded shell value said 6).

entityIds._note: Stable graph anchors (spec DEVSEO-016..018). The software @id is anchored to the category page even while the full node still renders on the homepage - Phase 3 moves the node; the @id never changes.

compliance.claim: Registered with the UK MHRA as a Class I medical device, UKCA marked
HIPAA and GDPR aligned; PIPEDA/PHIPA and CCPA requirements met
SOC 2 aligned; ISO 27001 aligned (ALIGNED, not certified - the /leaflet badges overstate this; flagged to owner 2026-08-31)
TLS 1.2+ in transit, AES-256 at rest; audio deleted permanently once the note is generated
